privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. It is GameNode's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect from you across our website, GameNode, and other sites we own and operate. We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we're collecting it and how it will be used. We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we'll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorised access, disclosure, copying, use or modification. We don't share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law. Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies. You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services. Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.
privacy.matomoNote: Previously, we used Matomo as our analytics tool of choice. We discontinued this service because of the maintenance cost of keeping our own instance.
privacy.posthogContent: for product and web analytics. This means Posthog's Javascript is injected in this website and used to collected information about your visited pages, usage patterns and etc. We never sell this data. It's used exclusively for improving our service.

privacy.whatAreCookiesContent: As is common practice with almost all professional websites this site uses cookies, which are tiny files that are downloaded to your computer, to improve your experience. This page describes what information they gather, how we use it and why we sometimes need to store these cookies. We will also share how you can prevent these cookies from being stored however this may downgrade or break certain elements of the sites functionality.

mcp.claudeSteps: In Customize → Connectors, select + Add → Add custom connector. Name it GameNode and enter the URL below. Review the detected OAuth settings, choose Sign in now, and use Claude’s published identity or automatic registration. Add the connector, then Connect and enable it in your conversation.
mcp.chatgptSteps: On ChatGPT web, open Plugins, select + → Add custom MCP server. Name it GameNode and paste the URL under Connection → Server URL. Select OAuth with discovered client registration (CIMD or DCR), review the warning and select Create as a plugin. Connect your GameNode account, then enable the plugin in your conversation.
mcp.hostedHelp: Opening the provider starts setup there. You still need to add GameNode and authorize it. Account, workspace and security policies may restrict custom MCP setup; organization owners may need to add it first.
mcp.launchError: Could not open the browser. Open this address manually and follow the instructions above:
mcp.prompt: Configure GameNode for {{client}} using {{url}} with Streamable HTTP and OAuth 2.1 discovery, PKCE and automatic client registration. Inspect existing configuration; add or update only the GameNode entry and preserve unrelated settings. Let me complete browser sign-in and consent. Use the client’s normal credential storage; never extract cookies or ask for session tokens, API keys or secrets in chat. The permissions I may review are: {{scopes}}. Request only the scopes needed. List tools and perform one read-only game search to verify. Do not change my library, reviews or posts as a setup check. {{hosted}}
mcp.hostedPrompt: Guide me through the provider’s graphical setup if you cannot configure it directly. Local Codex or Claude Code configuration does not configure the hosted service.
mcp.oauth: Authentication: OAuth 2.1 with discovery, PKCE and automatic client registration. No manual client secret or API key is supplied.
mcp.scopes: Supported permissions (you review the requested subset at consent)
